title: Code and derived data for: Rising South Asian aerosol left no detectable imprint on northern Indian Ocean low clouds (2003–2024)
description: Analysis code (data download, per-cell ridge and LightGBM cloud-controlling-factor attribution, year-block bootstrap, droplet-number susceptibility, IMO 2020 shipping-lane difference-in-differences, figures), result tables and figures for a study of whether rising aerosol over the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal brightened low clouds over 2003–2024. Raw inputs (CERES, MERRA-2, ERA5, CAMS EAC4, EDGAR v8.1) are public and fetched by albedo/download.py; they are not included.
